description: Choose a mode, market and optional filters to collect Trendyol products, reviews or answered questions.

categoryUrls.description: (mode=category, bestSellers, newArrivals) Paste Trendyol category, brand or campaign URLs, or a category ID.
categoryUrls.title: Category, brand or campaign URLs

couponsOnly.description: Keep products that show a coupon or discount code.
couponsOnly.title: With coupons only

discountedOnly.description: Keep products whose displayed price is below a higher reference price.
discountedOnly.title: Discounted only

fastDeliveryOnly.description: Keep products with same-day, next-day or express delivery.
fastDeliveryOnly.title: Fast delivery only

gender.description: Optional gender filter for listing modes.
gender.title: Gender

includeDetails.description: For listing modes, open each product page to add variants, attributes, seller details, delivery estimates and social proof.
includeDetails.title: Enrich with product details

includeQna.description: Collect answered question rows for each product, in addition to product records.
includeQna.title: Include answered questions

includeReviews.description: Collect review rows for each product, in addition to product records.
includeReviews.title: Include reviews

market.description: Trendyol storefront to use. Prices and currency follow this market.
market.title: Storefront

maxItems.description: Maximum product records for listing and product modes, or product sources processed in reviews/qna modes.
maxItems.title: Max products

maxPrice.description: Maximum displayed price in the selected market's currency.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price

maxQna.description: Answered question rows to collect per product.
maxQna.title: Max answered questions per product

maxReviews.description: Review rows to collect per product.
maxReviews.title: Max reviews per product

minPrice.description: Minimum displayed price in the selected market's currency.
minPrice.title: Minimum price

minRating.description: Optional minimum average rating, applied after the listing is fetched.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

mode.description: What to collect. Search, category, store, best-seller and new-arrival modes return products; product returns full details; reviews and qna return those record types.
enumTitles: Browse a category, brand or campaign
Trending items (legacy alias for best sellers)
mode.title: Mode

newlyReleasedOnly.description: Keep products tagged as new by Trendyol.
newlyReleasedOnly.title: New releases only

officialSellerOnly.description: Keep products from sellers marked as official.
officialSellerOnly.title: Official sellers only

productUrls.description: (mode=product, reviews, qna) Paste product URLs, product paths or numeric product IDs.
productUrls.title: Product URLs or IDs

searchQueries.description: (mode=search, bestSellers, newArrivals) One or more keywords, e.g. sneakers, coffee machine, iPhone.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

searchUrls.description: (mode=search, bestSellers, newArrivals) Paste Trendyol search result URLs. Their query filters are preserved.
searchUrls.title: Search URLs

sortBy.description: Sort order for listing modes. Best-seller and new-arrival modes force their own sort.
sortBy.title: Sort by

specialOffersOnly.description: Keep products that show a promotion, flash sale or bundle offer.
specialOffersOnly.title: With special offers only

storeUrls.description: (mode=store) Paste seller store URLs or seller IDs.
storeUrls.title: Seller store URLs

title: Trendyol Scraper Input
